# Kansai Karate Tarragindi — AI-readable business summary
# https://kansaikaratetarragindi.com.au

## About
Kansai Karate Tarragindi is a traditional Japanese karate school located at
St Luke's Anglican Church Hall, 193 Ekibin Road East, Tarragindi QLD 4121,
Australia (from Monday 2 November 2026; previously Wellers Hill Bowls Club). The school
is led by Sensei Jason Sallaway. A licensed dojo of Kansai Karate Academy, led by
Shihan Stephen Kelly, affiliated with Karate Queensland and
Karate Australia.

## Contact
Phone: 0480 566 172
Email: jason@kansaikaratetarragindi.com.au
Address: St Luke's Anglican Church Hall, 193 Ekibin Road East, Tarragindi QLD 4121 (from Monday 2 November 2026)
Website: https://kansaikaratetarragindi.com.au

## Programs
Cubs (Ages 3-4): A gentle, fun first step into karate for little ones.
Little Lions (Ages 5-6): Foundational karate for early primary school children.
Juniors (Ages 7-12): Karate for primary school children.
Teens Karate (Ages 13-17): Structured karate designed specifically for teenagers.
Adult Karate (Ages 18+): Traditional karate for adults of all fitness levels.

## Class Schedule (Tarragindi dojo, from Monday 2 November 2026)
Monday: Cubs 4:00pm–4:30pm, Little Lions 4:30pm–5:15pm, Juniors 5:15pm–6:00pm, Teens & Adults 6:00pm–6:45pm
Tuesday: Little Lions 4:15pm–5:00pm, Juniors 5:00pm–5:45pm, Teens & Adults 5:45pm–6:30pm
Thursday: Cubs 4:15pm–4:45pm, Little Lions 4:45pm–5:30pm, Juniors 5:30pm–6:15pm, Juniors, Teens & Adults combined 6:15pm–7:00pm, Teens & Adults 7:00pm–7:45pm
No classes on Wednesday, Friday, Saturday or Sunday.

## Free Trial
All programs offer a free first lesson. Book online at https://kansaikaratetarragindi.com.au

## Service Area
Tarragindi, Wellers Hill, Moorooka, Annerley, Salisbury, Rocklea, Yeronga,
Greenslopes, Holland Park, Wishart, Brisbane southside, Queensland, Australia.
